post.summary: Import inspections from a CSV file
post.description: Multipart upload with one field named `file`: UTF-8 CSV, header row, columns `serial_number`, `characteristic`, `measured_value`, optional `inspected_at` and `defect_type_codes` (separated by `|`). At most 1 MiB and 5000 data rows. Every row is validated first; one invalid row rejects the whole file with 422 and no inspection is written.
